音色类型，默认不填时：返回小模型语种音色。支持传入：
Cosyvoice，返回Cosyvoice大模型音色示例。
description.en: The voice type. If you do not specify this parameter, the operation returns voices from the small model by default. Set this parameter to `CosyVoice` to retrieve voices from the Cosyvoice large model.
